A delightful course overflowing with shrimp! Enjoy a variety of popular dim sum alongside Hong Kong pot tea, perfect for tantalizing your taste buds. This course features six types of dim sum, ranging from classic favorites to popular selections, including fragrant radish cake and juicy xiaolongbao. For the main dish, choose between aromatic Hong Kong-style fried noodles or a comforting bowl of Hong Kong congee. Finish off with a homemade dessert for a sweet moment of relaxation. Visually stunning and Instagram-worthy, this course is ideal for girls' parties, lunch banquets, and welcome and farewell gatherings.
